name: GS.joinWoman_worse_right
lines: n : ℕ
w m : Preferences n
μ ν : Matching (Fin n) (Fin n)
hμ : Matching.IsStable (MatchingMarket.ofEquivData w m) μ
hν : Matching.IsStable (MatchingMarket.ofEquivData w m) ν
j i : Fin n
hji : joinWoman μ ν hμ hν j = i
hνji : mPartner ν hν i = j
⊢ List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i) ≤ List.idxOf j (w.prefs i)
hνw : wPartner ν hν j = i
case pos
heq : wPartner μ hμ j = i
case neg
heq : ¬wPartner μ hμ j = i
this : mPartner μ hμ i = j
hbranch : joinWoman μ ν hμ hν j = wPartner ν hν j
⊢ joinWoman μ ν hμ hν j = wPartner ν hν j
hlt0 : List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j) < List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j)
⊢ List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j) < List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j)
hge : ¬List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j) < List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j)
⊢ False
hge : List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j) ≤ List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j)
hbranch :
(if List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j) ≤ List.idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) (m.prefs j) then wPartner μ hμ j
else wPartner ν hν j) =
wPartner ν hν j
hbranch : wPartner μ hμ j = wPartner ν hν j
hlt0 : List.idxOf i (m.prefs j) < List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j)
hlt0 hlt : List.idxOf i (m.prefs j) < List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j)
this : List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i) < List.idxOf j (w.prefs i)

steps.tactic: have hνw : wPartner ν hν j = i := (wPartner_eq_iff ν hν).mpr hνji
by_cases heq : wPartner μ hμ j = i
have : mPartner μ hμ i = j := (wPartner_eq_iff μ hμ).mp heq
have hbranch : joinWoman μ ν hμ hν j = wPartner ν hν j := by rw [hji, hνw]

have hlt0 : (m.prefs j).idxOf (wPartner ν hν j) < (m.prefs j).idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) :=
  by
  by_contra hge
  push_neg at hge
  unfold joinWoman at hbranch
  rw [if_pos hge] at hbranch
  exact heq (hbranch.trans hνw)
have hlt : (m.prefs j).idxOf i < (m.prefs j).idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) := hlt0

have :=
  opposed_preferences w m μ hμ (wj := i) (wj' := wPartner μ hμ j) (m' := mPartner μ hμ i) (matchW_wPartner μ hμ j) hlt
    (matchM_mPartner μ hμ i)
